purpose: Behavior contract for deterministic AssetRecipes, prioritized controls, scoped evidence, capability matching, rights gates, interaction constraints and ControlBench evaluation.

cases.prompt: 为锁定人物生成 3x3 表情定妆页，只改变每格表情。
脸部身份和身体比例不可变化，风格可协商。
assertions: identity and body are hard controls

cases.prompt: 绑定正脸、全身、姿势、服装、深度和灯光观察。
assertions: each observation has one explicit role and scope
quality and rights profile are present
style evidence cannot satisfy identity evidence

cases.prompt: 当前任务要求全身身份、多人交互和精确姿势，但适配器仅支持脸部身份。
assertions: partial support is not treated as strong support

cases.prompt: 权重允许研究使用，但商业用途未知。
assertions: execution is blocked for commercial publication
permission is not inferred from public availability

cases.prompt: 角色右手扶柱、双脚承重于石地、左袖被柱体局部遮挡，并受侧风影响。
assertions: support and body weight are explicit
hair and garment environment response are explicit

cases.prompt: 验证人物身份、服装、场景地理、互动、分镜连续性和权利。
assertions: character, appearance, scene, interaction, storyboard and rights dimensions
machine checks and human review coexist
failed criteria route to one-variable repair

cases.prompt: 让模型一次性直接画完整九宫格并在每格写字。
assertions: labels are added during deterministic assembly
